title: The Invisible Life of Addie LaRue
author: V. E. Schwab
summary: In 1714, a young French woman desperate to escape an arranged marriage makes a bargain with a dark god and is cursed to be forgotten by everyone she meets. Three centuries later, a man in a New York bookshop remembers her name.
readIf: you like a lyrical, melancholy story of art, memory and being seen, spanning centuries.
skipIf: you want a faster plot, as it moves between timelines and spends a lot of time on mood.

pairings.reason: Another romantic, atmospheric fantasy about magic, a bargain and a love that crosses time.
A brighter story about a woman reconsidering the lives she might have lived.
A more labyrinthine, book-obsessed fantasy for readers who loved the storytelling here.
